description: Header file defining the TDKB_TR181Stub class, which provides an interface for TR-181 parameter operations via JSON-RPC methods, including get, set, add, delete, and set-only functions. It also declares inherited lifecycle methods and includes necessary external dependencies.

classes.name: TDKB_TR181Stub
classes.description: A class implementing JSON-RPC server methods for TR-181 parameter management, inheriting from RDKTestStubInterface and AbstractServer.

methods.name: TDKB_TR181Stub_Get
methods.description: Handles retrieval of TR-181 parameters based on request JSON.

methods.name: TDKB_TR181Stub_Set
methods.description: Handles setting TR-181 parameters based on request JSON.

methods.name: TDKB_TR181Stub_SetMultiple
methods.description: Handles setting multiple TR-181 parameters at once.

methods.name: TDKB_TR181Stub_AddObject
methods.description: Handles adding a new TR-181 object.

methods.name: TDKB_TR181Stub_SetOnly
methods.description: Handles setting a TR-181 parameter without retrieving.
